sources.title: Ipotesi di accordo di rinnovo del CCNL per i dipendenti da imprese della distribuzione cooperativa, Roma 29 marzo 2024 (deposito CNEL, accordo 183889, scansione firmata)

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: split. base_salary = minimo tabellare only. fixed_allowances per level: (1) CONTINGENZA frozen since January 1993, level-specific constant; (2) TERZO_ELEMENTO 3.07 EUR all levels, constant; (3) INDENNITA_FUNZIONE 250.76 EUR, Q only, constant since 2008. Total monthly = base_salary + CONTINGENZA + TERZO_ELEMENTO (+ INDENNITA_FUNZIONE for Q). Verified against kitech.it Dec 2025 table: Q=2985.20 (expected 2985.23), L1=2533.93 (expected 2533.96), L4=1763.99 (expected 1764.02). 3-cent gap = TERZO_ELEMENTO rounding (3.07 filcams vs 3.10 kitech); filcams used.

MODELLED TRANCHES: 2025-05-01 (third tranche, source-confirmed from filcams.cgil.it and kitech.it), 2025-12-01 (fourth tranche, confirmed), 2026-11-01 (fifth, derived), 2027-03-01 (sixth and final, derived). April 2023 and April 2024 tranches not modelled — pre-signing period. Derivation method: per-level ratios from confirmed Dec 2025 L4 increments (35 EUR/tranche); validated by independent check pre-2023 Q minimo = 1,897.32 EUR matching search snippet.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 (tredicesima December + quattordicesima June). Source: CCNL text (olympus.uniurb.it summary, kitech.it).

SENIORITY (Art. 182 of the testo ufficiale 2011, PDF pp. 195-196): ten triennial scatti of the service 'a decorrere dal 21° anno di età' (counted_from_age 21, from SeniorityFact.birth_date; without it the service counts from the start; c. 2 is the transition of 1 July 1975, kept as the first hire the rule covers), fixed amounts 'Dal 1° aprile 1987': Q 27,82, I 26,64, II 24,52, III 21,79, IV 19,93, V 18,84, VI 16,51, paid from the month after the triennium (c. 5). The economic renewal 2019 (CNEL 100291) replaces only art. 185 and the 2024 renewal (CNEL 183889) does not amend art. 182.
INPS: uses 2026-terziario.json (terziario sector). No bilateral fund substituting INPS contributions. CNEL code: H016.

APPRENTICESHIP (2024 RENEWAL): art. 75 of the signed ipotesi of 29 March 2024 (CNEL 183889, p. 43, scanned page read by OCR) keeps the under-classification of the 2020 text: 'di due livelli inferiori [...] per i primi 24 mesi dal 4° livello al 1° livello e di un livello inferiore [...] per la restante durata dello stesso'; 'di un livello inferiore [...] per l'intera durata del percorso di apprendistato per il 5° livello'. Tracks livelli_1_a_4 (1, 2, 3S, 3, 4S, 4) and livello_5 unchanged.

HOURLY DIVISOR: Art. 187 c. 2 (2011 official text, p. 201): 165 for the normal week of 38 hours (art. 113 c. 1), 167 for 38.5, 168 for 39 and 40, 182 for 42, 184 from 42.5 to 44. The engine keeps 165 and reads the others from Employment.full_time_weekly_hours (38.5, 39, 40, 42, 42.5, 43, 43.5, 44); for the life of that contract, the staff hired after its signature work 40 hours (art. 113 c. 5) and state it. The cooperative minori of title XV keep their own 40-hour week and divisor (art. 187 c. 3, art. 147): not told apart.

MODELLED TRANCHES (Nov 2026 / Mar 2027): confirmed by studioagostini.org (secondary source, June 2024 commentary on the Mar 2024 renewal). L4 increments: +35.00 EUR (01/11/2026), +40.00 EUR (01/03/2027). L1 increments: +56.39 EUR (01/11/2026), +64.44 EUR (01/03/2027). All per-level values match the reparametrized ratio from confirmed prior tranches. Source: studioagostini.org/ccnl-distribuzione-cooperativa-aumenti-fino-a-240-euro/

INDENNITA_FUNZIONE (Q): 250.76 EUR constant throughout 2023-2027 contract. Confirmed at Dec 2025 by kitech.it, unchanged since at least 2008. The 2024 renewal (IPSOA analysis, lavorofacile.it) modified Arts. 75 and 80-82 but did not alter the Q function allowance. Modelled with valid_from at the earliest salary period.

SENIORITY OF LEVELS 3S AND 4S: the Art. 182 table has rows III and IV only, while the minimum table of the 2024 renewal (art. 185, p. 70) prints 3S and 4S apart; the file pays 3S the III amount (21,79) and 4S the IV amount (19,93), a reading the text does not state.

limitation.remediation: Source the seniority amount of levels 3S and 4S (signed table or interpretation of the parties).

notes.text: UNA TANTUM: 350 EUR gross at L4 level (proportionally reparametrized per other levels), paid April 2024 and April 2025 to workers in service at 2024-03-29 signing date. One-off payment with no engine representation; deliberately excluded.
PRE-SIGNING TRANCHES: April 2023 (retroactive) and April 2024 tranches not modelled. Coverage starts at 2025-05-01 (first source-confirmed post-signing tranche).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: TERZO ELEMENTO (art. 186 c. 4): 3,10 EUR a month in provinces without collective surpluses, as the signed text prints; the renewal of 29 March 2024 does not amend art. 186. A Filcams pay table 2025-2027 prints 3,07: a summary table, not a signed text, so the signed amount is used. Where collective surpluses are in force, the frozen provincial amounts apply instead (not modelled: they depend on local bargaining).

PERMITS, LARGE COOPERATIVES (Allegato 13, Art. 113, Art. 115, Art. 61 C of the testo ufficiale 2011, signed 22 December 2011): a pool of 104 hours a year, 32 for the abolished holidays and 72 of reduction; the 38-hour week of Art. 113 c. 1 absorbs 96 of them and leaves 24 (8 plus 16 not absorbable, Art. 115 c. 1), the 40-hour week of the hires after the signing (Art. 113 c. 5) absorbs none (EmployerProfile/Employment full_time_weekly_hours); the hires after 22 December 2011 take the 72 hours at 50% after two years and 100% after four (Art. 61 C); a twelfth per whole month of service; not taken by 30 June of the next year, paid with the pay of that date, with no choice of the employer (Art. 115 c. 4). The 2019 and 2024 renewals do not amend these articles.

PERMITS, IMPRESE MINORI (Title XV, Art. 147 as renewed on 29 March 2024, CNEL 183889 pp. 59-60): a 40-hour week for every worker (Employment full_time_weekly_hours 40: the 104 hours, not absorbed); in the small firms of one unit or up to 20 full-time staff a unit (EmployerProfile.subsector 'piccola_impresa_minore') 60 hours a year, read as the 32 of ex festività and 28 of reduction, plus 6 from 1 April 2025 and 6 from 1 April 2026 (72, aim 88). Their new hires take the hours in full: the ROL ramp of Art. 61 C does not reach this sub-sector.

LEAVE AT TERMINATION (testo ufficiale 2011, p. 166 and Art. 187): ferie in twelfths, a fraction above fifteen days counting as a month, the indemnity 'dividendo per ventisei la retribuzione mensile di fatto'; the permit hours left at the hourly quota of Art. 187 (168 at 40 hours, 165 at 38).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 190 - Mensilita' supplementari (13a e 14a) (p. 202): "il lavoratore avrà diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare della 13a mensilità, per quanti sono i mesi interi di servizio prestati nella cooperativa intendendosi per tali le frazioni di mese superiori ai 15 giorni.". Match: more_than 15.

reviews.scope: The paga base nazionale of the 9 levels on the four modelled tranches of the renewal of 29 March 2024 (1/05/2025, 1/12/2025, 1/11/2026, 1/03/2027), derived from the paga base printed by the economic renewal of 19 February 2019 plus the Art. 185 increments printed by the 2024 renewal; all texts as deposited at CNEL.
findings: Ipotesi 29 marzo 2024 (CNEL 183889, 73-page scan read on the page image of PDF p. 70): Art. 185 prints only the per-level increments (01/04/2023, 01/04/2024, 01/05/2025, 01/12/2025, 01/11/2026, 01/03/2027; IV livello 30, 70, 30, 35, 35, 40 = 240), not the resulting minimi. The level labels (quadro, 1, 2, 3S, 3, 4S, 4, 5, 6) are the file codes; each row's increments sum to the printed TOTALE (within one or two cents of rounding, e.g. quadro 425,01 against 425,00).

The base is the 'Paga Base Nazionale dal 01.07.2019' table of the economic renewal of 19 February 2019 (CNEL 100291, p. 3; 'III° Liv.Super' = 3S, 'IV° Liv. Super' = 4S). No minimi increase applied between 1.7.2019 and 31.3.2023: the 2019 accord ran to 31.12.2019 in ultrattività, and the Protocollo straordinario of 12 December 2022 (CNEL 161824) granted una tantum amounts plus the 30-euro acconto from 1/4/2023 that Art. 185 lists as its first tranche.

35 of the 36 file values equal paga base 1.7.2019 + cumulated Art. 185 increments to the cent; 4S on 1/03/2027 is 1411.61 in the file against 1153.29 + 32.29 + 75.35 + 32.29 + 37.67 + 37.67 + 43.06 = 1411.62 and is corrected. The file's base_salary is the paga base nazionale (conglobata) only, with contingenza and terzo elemento as fixed allowances; this matches the item both tables print.
The file's coverage note calls the 2026-11-01 and 2027-03-01 tranches 'derived' by per-level ratios; they are printed increments in Art. 185 and the note can be updated.
The ruleset now names the CNEL deposit of the text signed by ANCC-Coop, Confcooperative Consumo e Utenza, AGCI Agrital, Filcams-CGIL, Fisascat-CISL and Uiltucs: source_type contracting_party.

reviews.scope: The hourly divisors of art. 187 (PDF p. 201) and the normal week of art. 113 (PDF pp. 151-152) of the 2011 official text, read by a separate research session and checked again on the text layer.
findings: Art. 187 c. 2: 165 for 38 hours, 167 for 38.5, 168 for 40 and 39, 182 for 42, 184 from 42.5 to 44: work_rules.time_supplements.week_divisors, hourly_divisor_weekly_hours 38.
The coverage note cited art. 198 and a 195 divisor for 45 hours: art. 198 is the resignation for marriage and art. 187 sets no 45-hour divisor.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 10 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 36 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Terzo elemento against art. 186 of the signed text and the later renewals.
findings: The file paid 3.07 from a secondary table; art. 186 c. 4 prints 3,10 and no later renewal amends it (research .private/research/work/r-distr-coop). Corrected on all levels.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 19 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 36 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 187 c. 2 of the 2011 official text (PDF p. 201, text layer).
findings: The divisors of the half-hour weeks (167 for 38.5, 184 from 42.5) are now expressible: added 38.5, 42.5 and 43.5 to time_supplements.week_divisors.

reviews.scope: Art. 75 of the signed ipotesi di accordo of 29 March 2024 deposited at the CNEL (accordo 183889, PDF p. 43, OCR of the page image).
findings: The 2024 renewal keeps two levels below for the first 24 months and one below after for destinations 4 to 1, one below throughout for level 5: the encoded tracks hold; limitation apprenticeship_2024_text_unread removed.

reviews.scope: Art. 182 of the testo ufficiale 2011 (seniority), against the renewals 2019 and 2024.
findings: Read Art. 182 in the text PDF (pp. 195-196): the seven amounts of the file match the table; the service counts from the 21st year of age, which the file did not apply. Upgraded the provenance from the aggregator to the signed text, added counted_from_age 21, and narrowed the proxy limitation to the 3S and 4S amounts, which the table does not print.

reviews.scope: Artt. 61 C, 113, 115 and Allegato 13 of the testo ufficiale 2011; Art. 147 of the renewal of 29 March 2024.
findings: The file had the ferie but no permit. Added the 104-hour pool with the 38-hour absorption that leaves 24 hours, the ramp of the hires after 22 December 2011 and the fixed 30 June deadline; recorded the imprese minori hours of Art. 147 (2024) as a limitation, the file having no input for them.

reviews.scope: Art. 147 of the renewal of 29 March 2024 (imprese minori).
findings: Added the hours of the small imprese minori (60, +6 from April 2025, +6 from April 2026) under the sub-sector piccola_impresa_minore and closed imprese_minori_permits; the other imprese minori work 40 hours and keep the 104. Recorded that the Art. 61 C ramp still applies to their new hires.

reviews.scope: Art. 147 of the renewal of 29 March 2024 against the ramp of Art. 61 C.
findings: The 60 hours of the small imprese minori are 'per tutti i lavoratori dipendenti': the ramp now excludes the sub-sector piccola_impresa_minore; closed small_cooperative_new_hire_ramp.

reviews.scope: Ferie at termination and Art. 187 of the testo ufficiale 2011.
findings: The file had no basis for the leave left at termination: added the twelfths (more than 15 days a month), the 1/26 indemnity and the hourly quota of the permits.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.quote: L'indennità sostitutiva delle ferie si calcola dividendo per ventisei la retribuzione mensile di fatto di cui all'art. 184. [Art. 187:] La quota oraria della retribuzione, sia normale che di fatto, si ottiene dividendo l'importo mensile per i seguenti divisori orari

source_document.title: CCNL Terziario-Distribuzione Cooperativa (ANCC-Legacoop/Confcooperative)
